body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2005') -- <Visual News> 1. Booths-Samsung booth Of the companies attending KES 2005, the most notable companies are Samsung and LG, the two giants in Korea as well as in the global electronics market. Since their booths are facing each other ironically, visitors consciously or unconsciously find themselves comparing two of them, which is quite interesting. Then, why don’t YOU also look around and find differences? Let’s get started with the appearance first.
